scope: Real250 contact supplement only; synthetic180 evidence is separate.
claim_limits: No screenshot pixels or actual sound are evaluated.
Contact printouts have3decimal precision; resolver fields additionally compare HP/critical/RNG bits.
Cross-run actor/projectile IDs and outer iteration order are not compared.

baseline.scope: Same-run identities + frame + exact HP-bit endpoints establish the contact join. Contact-frame material observations are distinct from observed handle transitions; missing post100 original-handle logs do not prove restoration. LinearRgba base colors use standard linear-to-sRGB conversion; emissive stays linear and alpha stays unchanged. Unmatched rows do not establish a tier. PNG candidates need visual review, not exact-frame claims.
